sentences.text: Researchers employed structure-based drug design to identify GTA182, a compound that shrank tumors in mice carrying human cancer cells lacking the MTAP gene while sparing those with the normal gene.

In a mouse model of brain cancer, the drug reduced tumor size by 59% and extended survival beyond 91 days, whereas a human clinical trial reported safety and tumor shrinkage in approximately 30% of patients.
The authors conclude that GTA182 is a promising treatment option for cancers that have lost the MTAP gene, noting the results are limited to the specific models and trials described.
